question: Does OBS change its encoding bitrate and recover the original viewer after upload loss?
measurement: Host-generated timestamp via local MPEG2 source, OBS encoding to decoded Chromium picture, excluding capture and physical display scanout.
limitations: macOS x264, not Windows hardware encoding.
Local NAT gateway, not public Internet or TURN.
Bare WHEP reader, not application recovery or iPhone Safari.
OBS RTMP uses AAC. Its WHEP viewer measures video only; WHIP includes Opus audio.
TCP aggregation allowed about 3 MB in the 60-packet gateway queue; RTMP delay is specific to this buffering model.
